shortDescription: Own and develop end-to-end features for an agricultural supply-chain platform. Work across data ingestion, financial workflows, analytics, authentication, data-heavy interfaces, and integrations.
Built Python and AWS solutions, led technical work, mentored junior developers, reviewed code, wrote technical documentation, and delivered reusable React and GraphQL features.
Worked as a React and Django full-stack developer, building responsive interfaces, integrating GraphQL APIs, and contributing to Python scripts, PostgreSQL data modelling, and backend features.
Worked on a software product with a team of four, contributing mainly to React features for cart and slot management and implementing cookie-based authentication with Spring Boot.
